verdicts.reason: A breaks up the signature lockup. The 'Perfect Taste' headline is pulled out of its gold leaf wreath, shrunk and pushed up into the top-left. The empty wreath is left floating lower down over the busy fig slices, so the headline is weak and the leaves clutter the food photo. B keeps the headline locked inside the wreath, at the right scale and position, with the photo cropped sensibly for the wider canvas. Its only flaws are minor: some leaves overlap the fruit, as in the original, and the lockup sits a little left of centre, close to the edge of the busy fruit.
